brief.headline: Push payment from 45 days to 30 days to free up ₹2.25 L cash, and qualify Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a second source for rigid plastic packaging.

priceAsk.summary: Hold price at current level; focus on payment terms first.
priceAsk.basis: Market asking prices for similar 28 mm PP caps are ₹0.85–0.95/pc typical, with modest room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume — our current pricing sits in the MARKET-FAIR band, so squeeze here is limited unless we commit bigger volumes or relax specs.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.25 L freed up for us; a further shift to 15 days would free another ₹1.13 L.

brief.financialLeverage: Abhinav publishes no financials, so we can't see their cash position or how big we are to them. Our ₹27.42 L annual spend is meaningful for a specialty LLP, but without their revenue or health data we must lean on our own purchasing power and the four strong alternates we've lined up. The lack of transparency means we should move carefully — push on payment terms and qualify a second source, but don't corner them blindly.

evidence.point: We spend ₹27.42 L a year with them
Current payment is 45 days after receipt
Cutting payment to 30 days frees up cash for us
Market asking price for a 28 mm PP cap is typically in a fair band
HDPE resin import unit value gives a raw-material baseline
The supplier does not publish financials

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health B (65/100) — top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); revenue ₹1010.97 Cr, health B (73/100) — a robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: A manufacturer lead from market research (India-Pan, Medium confidence) — verify capability and pricing before any RFQ.

risks: Abhinav's financials are not public — we fly blind on their cash health and how much our ₹27.42 L matters to them; push too hard and we may destabilize a supplier we can't read.
Market price headroom is modest (₹0.65–0.80/pc only at higher volume or looser spec) — a big price fight here will yield little unless we change our own terms.
We have no internal price benchmark (no bestPriceWePay) — we're using market asks and alternates, not our own track record, so the price ask is weaker than usual.
Four strong alternates exist, but none are qualified yet — naming Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a second source is a negotiating position, not a fallback we can execute tomorrow.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to move to 30-day payment terms to match how we work with our other packaging suppliers, and we're qualifying Manjushree and Mold-Tek as second sources — let's talk about how we keep this partnership strong while we bring our terms in line.
